scope: Two quiet integrated sessions: complete supported smooth Euler movement workload; active Ada baseline vs all adopted mass/spatial/scan changes vs pinned normal SIMD C. Not an isolated timing attribution to one guard.
ci95: Paired block-median bootstrap, per case within session; no multiplicity correction. All 33 cases have CI95 upper bound below 1 in both sessions.
aggregation: Ranges over the three scenarios and two sessions of each model; no unweighted overall average or summed speedup.
tail_scope: p95 of trajectory-average step cost, not individual-step latency
remaining_gap: C is still faster on every measured model.
